questions.question_text: What is the main advantage of using a smartphone for photography compared to a DSLR camera?

options.text: Smartphones always produce higher quality images than DSLRs
Smartphones are more expensive but have better lenses
Smartphones are portable, always with you, and have easy-to-use features like portrait mode
Smartphones allow for more manual control over settings than DSLRs

correct_answer.text: Smartphones are portable, always with you, and have easy-to-use features like portrait mode

questions.question_text: What does the "Rule of Thirds" composition technique suggest for creating a balanced photo?

options.text: Place the subject in the exact center of the frame
Place the subject along the lines or intersections of an imaginary 3x3 grid
Always shoot from a low angle to make the subject look bigger
Fill the entire frame with the subject to avoid empty space

correct_answer.text: Place the subject along the lines or intersections of an imaginary 3x3 grid

questions.question_text: When is the best time to shoot photos using natural light for a warm, flattering glow?

options.text: Midday when the sun is directly overhead
During golden hour, just after sunrise or before sunset
On a completely overcast day with no visible sun

correct_answer.text: During golden hour, just after sunrise or before sunset

questions.question_text: Which photo editing app is best suited for adding text and graphics to images, such as for YouTube thumbnails or Instagram Stories?
Why is creating a consistent visual style important for your digital content?

options.text: It makes your content look boring and predictable
It helps your content become instantly recognizable to followers and builds your brand identity
It ensures all your photos are taken with the same camera
It prevents you from experimenting with new photography techniques

correct_answer.text: It helps your content become instantly recognizable to followers and builds your brand identity
